skill_sources.method: web open; read full169-line current guideline

actual_use_details: Applied pinned JOEDESIGN review-only scope and ordered R/C1 responsibility table. Read assigned R drafts, raw sources/data, authority and criteria. Did not read builder integration-observations.md, another C1, critic output or evaluation rubric.

Used UI UX Pro Max for C1 U Accessibility/Responsive: explicit ux searches keyboard focus visible and responsive horizontal overflow both returned relevant first results (Focus States and Horizontal Scroll); read quick-reference guidance for naming, focus, native controls, status feedback, reachable content and viewport behavior. No new design-system generation because this is bounded review.

Used actual web-design-guidelines for C1 V Experience including CrossPage; fetched the current primary guideline and applied forms/semantics, state feedback, content handling and navigation/state rules to the assigned pinned criteria. No universal guideline-compliance certification.

Inspected supplied reference wide/narrow originals and all18 full target renders in labeled contact sheets, plus current narrow journey action frames and own focus screenshots. Read current app source, target raw observations and independent per-target DOM/keyboard recordings.

Ran own Edge/Playwright against an in-process ephemeral HTTP server, isolated contexts per target; all18 recreated row lists and sessionStorage IDs match original raw evidence. Replayed two complete keyboard and cross-page journeys. Server closed after the probes.
